title: JSON exception when receving historical values from 600SeriesAndroidUploder
body:
Using Medtronic 640G pump and 600SeriesAndroidUploder as collecting app. Xdrip runs on same android device as collector.
Normal behaviour in previous releases was that when pump is back in range, all historical values are read and broadcasted to Xdrip on reading device.
In latest release, only current value appears in Xdrip, history values do not appear.
Log shows - Got JSON exception org.json.JSONException: No value for direction

600SeriesAndroidUploader did not change and only change was upgrade of Xdrip on collecting device. I assume something changed in interface Xdrip is expecting to get.

comments.body:
After additional tests -
Problem does not occur on build from 2/7/18
Problem starts to happen on build from 4/7 onwards
Further code review show - changes were done on 4/7 at file 
at file: app/src/main/java/com/eveningoutpost/dexdrip/NSEmulatorReceiver.java
in function: bgReadingInsertFromData
slope parameter was added, reading it from direction parameter in JSON

I believe this addition does not comply with 600SeriesAndroidUploader
Please try the Sept 29th nightly and see if this resolves the problem. Thanks

I am using the Sept 29th nightly. xDrip is collecting old values, from time of connecting the Contour-Next-Link back. But xDrip is stopping at first old value found in the xDrip collection. Older values, back to 90 days ago are not fetched, if some values are already saved in between.

How to force xDrip to fill the gaps?
Just installed latest version and it works, no exception an history is uploaded, Thanks ! @jamorham
